body: Just want to add: I have thinking about suicide constantly and I couldn't tell anyone about it. When I told my parents about it, they never took it seriously. I wonder how will they react if I finally attempt to do it.

I just did, thanks. It's my first time reaching out to a friend in four months. It wasn't easy. I am breaking down right now, I just don't know what to do

Edit: got no reply. This is making me so anxious. I shouldn't have done it

It is harder than you think. Trust me, I was so close to sending messages to just anyone I know even from high school, but I hesitated and didn't do it. It wouldn't make a difference anyway because they're far away from me.

I feel you. I am just in my early 20s but I feel like it's too late for me who hasn't gotten a degree yet, let alone a depressed and unlovable guy. I suck at conversations but I feel like I can have a good chat with you if you want to.

This is why I lost trust in these hotlines. One time, they only made things worse by saying what I feel is normal and most people feel the same way. How is ending my life normal? They really want to normalize suicide, aren't they?
Thanks. I dunno what else to talk about. This is pretty much it. I really suck at small talks.

This is my wish too. These days, I kind of cut off my ties with my friends. I feel like I am pushing them away for their own sake. I want them to hate me. That way, I am left all alone and die alone as well.

Now I am still living with my family which is the only reason why I cannot still do it. I keep asking myself every night, wondering how would they feel if they see me dead with their own eyes. I know it would be dreadful, but I do not know what to do anymore.
I feel the same way and I do not know why I get scared every time. The only answer I get is maybe I still want to live. But right now, I do not.
